description: The ns3-mmwave-iab repository extends ns-3's mmWave cellular model with integrated access and backhaul. Developed by the University of Padova in a project with InterDigital Communications, it adds wireless relaying to an ns-3 NetDevice so that access and backhaul can share equipment and spectrum resources. Users configure cellular nodes, traffic and relay arrangements and inspect end-to-end network behaviour. Spatial detail, duration and geographic coverage are scenario-defined; the repository is not an observed telecom-network dataset. Public C++ source is free under GPL-2.0, with linked descriptions, examples and ns-3 documentation. A limitation is that the README explicitly labels the extension a work in progress, so unimplemented future functionality and complete standards compliance must not be assumed. Reuse also depends on the inherited mmWave and ns-3 build environment. This model supports comparisons of backhaul paths and access/backhaul capacity in communication infrastructure. It is distinct from the generic mmWave contributed module named in the catalogue's ns-3 record (platform-ns-3). Two linked 2018 papers describe path selection and end-to-end IAB simulation; this review did not reproduce their experiments.
